note: AIB's guide to fees and charges for personal accounts: a personal current account's monthly account fee is 6 euros, covering unlimited euro transactions; none for an AIB mortgage holder paying it from the account (not modelled). Debit-card stamp duty isn't modelled.

sources.title: AIB, A guide to fees and charges for personal accounts
sources.said: How much is the fee? → €6.00 per month per account for personal current accounts
